items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I was playing there and Eddie Atkins was playing drum on me. And Joe Howard was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about him when you were, he must have been pretty young when you first heard him, I guess?
Well, I'll tell you, he played with, uh, Willie and Joe. Joe Nicholas. That's my sister Kate, Jessica A. Mark. I've been playing at the West End, next to the Iowa College where we were.
Um, just the two of you played, then you played the, uh, trumpet, uh, Maurice on that. And, uh, Fess played the, uh, the accordion, huh?
